title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Darkest Fantasy Returns With a Surprise U.S. Release Ahead of Season 3
content:
Jujutsu Kaisen is easily one of the most popular Shonen series in recent years, and most of its success is thanks to the stunning adaptation by Studio MAPPA. While the first season was more than intersting enough, the director changed in Season 2, making the series even more famous among fans. Over the years, MAPPA has released several critically acclaimed series, and it’s one of the most renowned studios in the industry. One of the beloved series from the studio is Dorohedoro , based on an award-winning manga written and illustrated by Q Hayashida. The anime premiered in 2020, two years after the manga reached its conclusion. Following the anime debut, the studio took six years to release a second season .

The sequel season gained even more popularity when it was released in April this year as part of the Spring 2026 anime lineup. While fans await updates on the third season, the official website of Viz Media reveals that the hardcover volume of Dorohedoro Illustrations: Mud and Sludge will be released in the U.S. on September 22nd, 2026. The manga is famous for its gritty details and stellar art style, which perfectly suits the tone of the story. The artbook features illustrations, sketches, paintings, and more by the original creator. Viz Media also shared the link to pre-order the artbook on Amazon.

Does Dorohedoro Season 3 Have a Release Date?

The third season hasn’t shared any updates on the release date or even a window. However, fans won’t have to wait another six years for a new season. Only a few days after the second season finale, MAPPA shared the first look at Season 3 during its 15th anniversary event in June. The 90-second trailer shares glimpses of what to expect from the story in the upcoming season.

Considering how the series has already dropped a massive update this early. We can expect more updates on the anime by the end of the year or in the first half of 2027. While the series originally premiered on Netflix, Crunchyroll also licensed both seasons this year. Fans can watch the anime on either platform, where we can also expect the third season to drop.

What to Expect From Dorohedoro Season 3

Caiman’s struggles to uncover the dark secrets about the Hole and his identity continue in the second season. The anime’s latest season ends on a massive cliffhanger as the story hints towards the connection between Aikawa, Caiman, and Kai. The story will take a drastic turn in the third season as Caiman is closer than ever to learning the truth about his identity. We can also expect the story to delve deeper into Nikaido’s dramatic awakening as well as the villains working in the shadows.

It won’t be the final season of the anime since there’s a huge chunk of story left to adapt. We can expect the anime to follow the same 12-episode format, covering around 35 to 40 chapters total. The cast and crew will be the same in the upcoming season as well, with Yuichiro Hayashi returning as the series director.

title: Live-Action One Piece Season 3 Reveals 4 New Cast Members
content:
The One Piece Day '26 livestream event on Sunday revealed new cast members for One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta , the third live-action season based on Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga .

The newly announced cast members are:

• Emilio Sakraya as Koza

• Omid Abtahi as Toto

• Nabeel Khan as Chaka

• Jamie Ward as Pell

The third season has previously cast Cole Escola as Bon Clay, Xolo Maridueña as Portgas D. Ace, Awdo Awdo as Mr. 1, and Daisy Head ( Dungeons and Dragons: Honor Among Thieves , Shadow and Bone ) as Miss Doublefinger.

Ian Stokes and Joe Tracz are co-showrunners, writers and executive producers for the third season.

One Piece: Into the Grand Line , the second live-action season , debuted on Netflix on March 10. The first two episodes played in over 200 theaters in Canada, the United States, and Japan on the same day.

The second season began production in July 2024. As series creator Oda previously stated , the second season covers the story up to the Drum Island arc. This includes Loguetown, Reverse Mountain and Twin Cape, Whiskey Peak, Little Garden, and Drum Island.

The second season added Joe Tracz ( Percy Jackson and the Olympians ) as a writer, executive producer, and co-showrunner. He joined the first season's writer, executive producer, and co-showrunner Matt Owens . Season 1 co-showrunner Steve Maeda served as executive producer. Owens announced in March 2025 he was leaving the show after production on season 2 ended to work on his mental health.

The live-action One Piece series debuted exclusively on Netflix in August 2023. The first season had eight episodes, as opposed to 10 episodes as originally reported. The series won awards for "Outstanding Original Song for a Children's or Young Teen Program" and "Outstanding Stunt Coordination for a Live Program" at The 3rd Annual Children's & Family Emmy Awards.

Tomorrow Studios , a partnership between producer Marty Adelstein ( Prison Break , Teen Wolf ) and ITV Studios, produced the first live-action season. Becky Clements served as an executive producer with Maeda.

title: Two New 'One Piece' Anime Movies for 2027 and 2029
content:
The second day of the " One Piece Day'26 " event at Makuhari Messe in Chiba announced on Sunday that Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga is receiving two new anime movies. The first film, titled One Piece Film God Valley , is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in Summer 2027, while the second film, One Piece Film Baad is set to release in 2029. The official website also revealed a special teaser promo and the logos of both films.

One Piece Film God Valley marks the first theatrical release for the franchise since One Piece Film: Red in August 2022, which earned 20.33 billion yen (approx. US$127.89 million) at the box office.

The first movie will coincide with the 30th anniversary of the manga's serialization on July 22, 2027. The title of the second movie, One Piece Film Baad , features a prominent letter "D" in its logo, which was handwritten by Oda himself.

Oda began serializing the adventure fantasy manga in Weekly Shounen Jump magazine in July 1997. Shueisha released the 115th volume on July 3. The manga has over 600 million cumulative copies of its volumes in circulation.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in November 2002 and released the 112th volume on July 7. The 113th volume is planned for a November 10 release. Crunchyroll streams the long-running television anime adaptation by Toei Animation .

title: One Piece God Valley Anime Movie Officially Announced for 2027, BAAD Film for 2029
content:
ONE PIECE new anime film is officially covering the God Valley Incident, one of the biggest events in the story. Oda previously teased the new film at Jump Festa 2026, saying it was about something he was sure everyone would be interested in . This will be the 15th movie for the franchise. In addition, ONE PIECE FILM: BAAD Was announced for 2029 The God Valley Incident featured the fight where Roger teamed up with Garp to fight against Rocks.

The last movie for the franchise was ONE PIECE FILM RED , which premiered in August 2022. The movie grossed over ¥2.25 billion (~$15 million), with 1.57 million attendees in the opening weekend in Japan. That made the biggest opening-weekend numbers when it came to both the audience and earnings among films of 2022. It also quickly became the best-performing film in ONE PIECE ‘s history.

The ONE PIECE franchise, created by Eiichiro Oda, is one of the most successful manga and anime series of all time. Since its serialization began in 1997, ONE PIECE has exceeded over 600 million copies in print worldwide. Chapter 1190 was released on August 9. The ONE PIECE anime, animated by Toei Animation, first premiered in 1999 and it entered the Elbaph Arc in April 2026 after a 3-month break.

title: Murciélago TV Anime Debuts in January 2027
content:
HIDIVE revealed at Anime NYC on Saturday the super teaser promotional video and January 2027 debut, and confirmed the television format for the anime adaptation of Kana Yoshimura 's Murciélago manga.

HIDIVE describes the story:

Fight evil with evil— Kuroko Koumori, a former death-row inmate chosen through extraordinary legal measures to serve as a state- sanctioned executioner. By her side is her watchdog and partner, Hinako Tozakura, whose extraordinary driving skills are second to none. As one heinous crime after another lands on their doorstep, the strongest duo takes on the darkness lurking within society. A wildly unconventional, addictively insane, and dangerously intoxicating buddy action series is set in motion—

Matsuo Asami ( The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom , SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table episode director) is directing the anime at Satelight and Staple Entertainment . Takashi Naoya ( Am I Actually the Strongest? ) is the chief director and is also handling the series composition. Kiyoshi Tateishi is designing the characters. Masanori Akita and Yūichi Tsuchiya are composing the music.

Yoshimura launched the ongoing manga in Square Enix 's Young Gangan magazine in 2013. Square Enix published the manga's 29th compiled book volume on July 24. Yen Press is releasing the original Murciélago manga in English, and it will publish the 27th volume in English on September 22.

The manga has 2.3 million copies in circulation worldwide.

Yoshimura launched the Murciélago Byproduct Araña manga in Square Enix 's Manga UP! app in January 2018 as a spinoff of Yoshimura's Murciélago . The manga ended in June 2020. The story focuses on the character Reiko Kuchiba.

title: The Moon on the Rainy Night Anime Listed for 2027
content:
Kodansha USA licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

One rainy night, Saki is rushing to a piano lesson when she crashes into a beautiful, long-haired girl, dropping her sheet music in the process. Saki stutters an apology, but the girl simply hands back her sheet music and leaves without a word. Saki begins her first day of high school the following morning, only to find the stranger from the night before sitting at the desk next to hers. She learns that the girl's name is Kanon and that she is not quite completely deaf, but very hard of hearing. Though Kanon needs to be close to people to read their lips, she tends to push people away with her icy demeanor. Through one kind gesture, Saki slowly begins breaking down the walls around Kanon, even as she feels something new blossoming within her.

Tomoe Makino ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai , A Tale of the Secret Saint , Woodpecker Detective's Office ) is directing the anime at CompTown . Shōgo Yasukawa ( Food Wars! Shokugeki no Soma , Mitsuboshi Colors , Rock is a Lady's Modesty is writing and overseeing the series scripts, and Ayumi Nishibata ( Otherside Picnic , Migi & Dali ) is designing the characters.

Kuzushiro ( A Mangaka's Weirdly Wonderful Workplace , Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san ) debuted the manga on Kodansha 's Comic Days website in June 2021. Kodansha published the manga's 12th volume in Japan on June 19. Kodansha USA released the eighth volume digitally on December 23.

title: 'Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official X account for the television anime adaptation of Satsuki Nakamura 's Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den ( Though I Am an Inept Villainess ) light novel announced three additional cast members on Sunday. The anime series premiered on July 12 at 11:45 p.m. on TV Tokyo, TV Osaka, TV Aichi, and other stations.

Cast Kimi Reiga: Kotono Mitsuishi ( Zombieland Saga ) Ran Hourin: Aya Hisakawa ( Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon ) Gen Gousetsu: Takako Honda ( Kara no Kyoukai )

Mitsue Yamazaki ( Maoujou de Oyasumi ) is directing the anime at Doga Kobo , with Yoshiko Nakamura ( Gekkan Shoujo Nozaki-kun ) handling the series composition. Ai Kikuchi ( Kawaii dake ja Nai Shikimori-san ) is designing the characters. Yukari Hashimoto ( Yubisaki to Renren ) is composing the music.

Nakamura originally began the fantasy romance novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in July 2020. Ichijinsha began printing the series under its Ichijinsha Novels imprint in December that year, featuring illustrations by Kana Yuki (number24). The 12th volume went on sale on March 31, with the 13th volume scheduled for a September 30 release.

Comic ZERO-SUM began serializing a manga adaptation by Ei Ohitsuji in December 2020. Ichijinsha published the tenth volume on March 31.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed both the light novel and manga in English in March 2023. The tenth light novel volume shipped on May 5, with the 11th volume scheduled to be released on September 22. The ninth manga volume was released on August 4.

News Submitted by NokkiMal

title: Kazé US Manga Imprint Plans to Launch With 5-8 Titles in 2027, to Grow to 25-30 Titles Per Year by 2029
content:
KAZÉ added it is not only expanding its presence to the U.S., but also to Brazil and Spain in 2027.

As HarperCollins is also the only Western publisher with a presence in Japan, KAZÉ stated it also plans to publish HarperCollins Japan 's original IPs, and also plans to publish manhwa , manhua, and original English "manga." The company also plans to target a wide range of genres, and target properties from top manga creators who have not had works published in the U.S. before. KAZÉ added it also plans to publish works from manga creators published from KAZÉ France and Germany.

The imprint also revealed its first title, Saxton Moore and Phillip Johnson's SOL Sistah original English manga. The company describes the title as " Ultraman meets Power Rangers in this Pan-African, kaiju-crushing, teen slice-of-life manga starring Atomika, a goddess-turned-highschooler juggling two very different lives."

KAZÉ stated at the panel the imprint will not use AI translations.

HarperAlley , which publishes the Plus-sized Misadventures in Love! manga in print, is KAZÉ 's sister imprint, and KAZÉ plans to draw on the experience of the HarperAlley team.

The KAZÉ team includes vice-president and publisher Andrew Arnold, editors Emilia Sowersby and Josh Sippie, art director Christina Quintero, and assistant designer Mikhail Fernandes .

In July 2025, HarperCollins acquired Crunchyroll 's manga publishing operations in France and Germany, returning the Crunchyroll Manga brand to its original name KAZÉ . All ongoing series from Crunchyroll Manga have been continuing without interruption and without changes to their current design. Starting in April 2026 releases now feature the KAZÉ branding.

KAZÉ was founded in France in 1994, and Shogakukan and Shueisha jointly acquired the company in 2009, and integrated it with Viz Media Europe .

Crunchyroll and Viz Media Europe closed the deal for Crunchyroll to become the majority owner of Viz Media Europe Group in December 2019. The companies announced the agreement in September 2019. Viz Media Europe Group comprised Viz Media Europe Group, AV Visionen, Anime Versand, VIZ Media Switzerland , KAZÉ , KAZÉ Manga, Anime on Demand , and Anime Digital Network (in partnership with the Média-Participations subsidiary Citel and Eye See Movies).

HarperCollins ' HarperVia imprint released Shion Miura 's Run with the Wind ( Kaze ga Tsuyoku Fuiteiru ) novel in English in October 2024. HarperVia has previously published such novels as The Tatami Galaxy , The Tatami Time Machine Blues , and Park Seolyeon's A Magical Girl Retires in English. HarperCollins will also release the late Saeko Himuro 's Ocean Waves novel in English in March 2027.

HarperCollins will also release the late Saeko Himuro 's Ocean Waves novel in English in March 2027.

title: Publang Announces 5 New BL Manhwa, Web Novel Titles at Anime NYC
content:
At its Anime NYC panel on Saturday, BL -focused publisher Publang announced five new titles, including three manhwa and two web novels.

The new lineup includes the manhwa Define the Relationship , The Hunter's Gonna Lay Low , and PASSION , as well as the web novels Healer and The Hunter's Gonna Lay Low . The titles are planned for upcoming release, with additional details still to be announced.

Define the Relationship , written by Flona and illustrated by Chada, is available on Lezhin . Publang plans to release the title in print with its first two volumes.

Publang will release both the original novel and manhwa adaptation of The Hunter's Gonna Lay Low . The novel is written by 103, while the manhwa features art by ligong, with an adaptation by MAGMA. The manhwa is available on Manta . The first two print volumes of the manhwa are planned for print release, while Publang will release novel through web serialization.

The publisher will also release the first two volumes of the PASSION manhwa , written by Yuuji with art by GangJak and an adaptation by Hound. The manhwa is available on Tappytoon .

Publang will release Healer , a web novel by Mechanist, through web serialization.

The publisher noted that the lineup expands its approach of licensing manhwa adaptations alongside the original novels, following titles such as Payback , Define the Relationship , and PASSION .

Publang , which began as a translation agency, has since grown into a publisher with a stated mission to produce the most faithful and contextually resonant translations possible. The company has previously emphasized its core editorial philosophy, “The Art of Localization," which rests on guiding principles:

• Faithful to the Original – Prioritizing the preservation of the author's voice and intent with minimal changes.

• Contextual Localization – Maintaining cultural markers such as Korean familial terms like “hyung” while restructuring text for clarity and flow in English.

title: GKIDS Licenses Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust Anime Film, Live-Action 5 Centimeters Per Second Film
content:
GKIDS announced on Saturday it has acquired the North American rights to the Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust anime film and the live-action film of Makoto Shinkai 's 5 Centimeters per Second anime film.

GKIDS describes the film:

After a young woman is seemingly abducted by the vampire Baron Meier Link, her father hires D – a vampire-hunting “Dunpeal” – to rescue her. As D rides across the wastelands, he must compete against a group of tough mercenary hunters, and confront the complex truth about the woman.

Hideyuki Kikuchi 's novels inspired the Vampire Hunter D original video anime ( OVA ) in 1985 and the Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust film in 2000. Discotek Media most recently released Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust on DVD and Blu-ray Disc in 2015. Urban Vision had previously released the film on DVD and VHS in 2002. Yoshiaki Kawajiri directed the film at Madhouse .

Sentai Filmworks most recently released the 1985 OVA on Blu-ray Disc in August 2025. Iconic Events Releasing and Anime Expo 's AX Cinema Nights program hosted the 40th anniversary screenings of the OVA in April 2025. HIDIVE and Shudder began streaming the OVA in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand in May 2025.

SixTONES member Hokuto Matsumura ( Suzume 's Sōta Munakata) stars in the live-action film.

Spoon produced the film, and TOHO distributed. Yoshiyuki Okuyama directed, and Ayako Suzuki wrote the script. Ayatake Ezaki composed the music. Kenshi Yonezu performs the theme song "1991."

GKIDS describes the film:

After transferring to the same elementary school, Takaki and Akari became best friends. However, their lives change when both their families are forced to relocate. After a year of separation, Takaki is about to reunite with Akari. As he sits on the train from Tokyo, memories of the past rush through Takaki's head, his meeting time with Akari drawing ever closer. Takaki and Akari begin to wonder if they will ever be able to see each other again, and share their secret feelings. Join Takaki on a journey into three interconnected tales of love and lost innocence that span the minutes and months of their lives.

The 5 Centimeters per Second anime opened in Japan in 2007.

Shinkai directed, wrote, and storyboarded the anime film, and was also the sound director, producer, and art director. Tenmon composed the music.
